avis.texte: This is a good sunblock for anyone with normal to oily skin. I have very dry skin so I have to pile on the moisturizer before applying the sunblock. I wish they made a moisturizing one for dry skin. It worked well under makeup and doesn't pill at all.

This is the absolute best SPF! It's as cosmetically elegant as a chemical sunscreen but without burning your eyes. It applies easily over all my serums and never pills under foundation. The consistency is thin, so it absorbs easily, and the peachy tint lets it blend in completely without any orange or white resudue on my light skin.

This is the best mineral sunscreen I've tried, with the added benefit that it has a high SPF of 50. It blends in so quickly and never pills under my makeup. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes when I apply it to the eyelids. I don't see any whitecast, but for reference I have light skin with a neutral golden-olive undertone.
Love the tint and the consistency of this lightly tinted sunscreen. It's got the perfect neutral tone and it doesn't leave me greasy. It's awesome!

Purchased this product because I damaged my skin barrier & my chemical sunscreen was burning my skin. I have combination, acne prone, & sensitive skin. This sunscreen did not irritate or burn my skin. I am a black woman & there is no white cast. LOVE
No white cast. It works great on my teenage daughter's acne prone and sensitive skin! I purchased 2 already! Just wish the price wasnt so high. I just have to keep on the lookout for sales.
there are better products for a lower price point. this is okay, it pills under makeup while blending. doesn't leave face super greasy.

I use Blume's Meltdown products religously (the cleanser, moisturizer, and oil), so I was super excited to find out that they had a new sunscreen product! Upon trying it, however, I was left sorely disappointed. I tried multiple days to layer this on top of my other morning products (again, Blume's own moisturizer and oil), but the sunscreen immediately pilled when applying. I hate nothing more than when a product pills, so this was a dealbreaker for me. I'm not sure if it was some sort of reaction between the sunscreen and the other products, but I can usually layer other products on top with no issues. So, disappointing for me (and I did return), but no one else is talking about this, so maybe it's also just a me problem lol Whatever the case, I'm now back on the hunt for a sunscreen that doesn't pill!

I really love this and docked it a star because of the price/size. This is an awesome tinted SPF. I've been looking for a mineral tinted SPF 50 that feels nice on the face, ans this is it. Love the liquid consistency and how it melts right into skin. Just wish it were a little less expensive.

avis.titre: Not too greasy or chalky, and a little goes a long way
avis.texte: All my life I have refused to wear sunscreen, preferring instead to cover up with clothing and a hat, and feeling really unsure about the safety of all the ingredients they use I most sunscreens. I'm getting older and starting to get more worried about skin cancer than I am about the potential toxins the sunscreen contains, so I decided to give this a try. Not too greasy, and I like that it's a pink color instead of a chalky white. And I really appreciate how far it goes. I only use two or three drops and it covers my entire face and neck. I think the sunspots on my nose are even starting to fade!

avis.titre: Got a re-up for the WINTER!
avis.texte: I LOVE this sunscreen! I just bought a re-up for the WINTER. Yes, WINTER! Ran out while on vacation, very hydrating, fully absorbs and no residues.

avis.titre: Looks great but smell too strong
avis.texte: Feels and look great on the skin, you can't believe its mineral! But the smell is way to strong, I can't use it. If Blume ever comes out with an unscented version I'll buy for sure!!

I love the product; I am fair in complexion and find it leaves no white cast on me. However, the problem for me is in the packaging; given the nature of the material, it is very stiff and hard to squeeze, causing accessibility problems for myself and anyone with dexterity limitations with their hands. I love the product, but cant use it if I cant get it out.
This sunscreen tops all other sunscreen brands. It's lightweight, CLEAN and leaves zero whitecast.

I wore it today for the first time. Not only was it light-weight and easy to apply, but it kept me protected from extreme sun exposure today better than my body sunscreen. I liked it so much, I just ordered two more bottles. This product will encourage me to actually wear sunscreen daily as it feels great on and is so easy to wear.

avis.titre: Really great, but smell could be issue for some
avis.texte: I love the consistency, and it seems to work well with my skin type (dry, acne prone) so far. The smell could be an issue for some, but otherwise love it!

avis.titre: Helps me feel confident with my skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen is the best sunscreen I've tried before. I goes on clear. I feel like it provides a blurr effect on my skin. I can go out without wearing any makeup. It helps me feel so confident in my own skin.
melts into my skin and leaves a nice glow! Did not break my skin out like other sunscreens

I typically don't like the feeling or smell of anything with SPF so I tend to avoid using it, even though I know how important it is to protect my skin. But Sunburst is such a game-changer for me! It's got such a great consistency, smell, and doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my face. Overall, would recommend!

This is the ultimate in multi-tasking skincare with SPF protection. Not only does it protect your skin from the sun, it also helps to hydrate and nourish, as well as improve your skin tone. There is no white cast with this sunscreen. It is easy to apply and feels lightweight on my skin. I am very impressed!

avis.titre: Light, soft, could spread a little easier
avis.texte: This has a nice soft feel on the skin and doesn't leave any white cast. I like knowing that I'm protected with a high SPF. The only downside for me is that it doesn't spread as easily as I would like so I feel like I need to use more to get enough coverage. Pics show before and after rubbing in on my hand.

avis.titre: Great for Acne Prone, Sensitive, and POC!
avis.texte: As someone who suffers from chronic acne with very sensitive skin, I can say this sunscreen is amazing. This does not clog my pores or leave a white cast. As a mixed race girly, this is awesome. Chemical sunscreens burn my eyes, and most other mineral sunscreens leave a white cast or clog my pores. Not this one! After using for two weeks with no side effects, I immediately went and bought 3 more!

Tested this out doing yard work and under makeup, and it delivers! I feel like the scent is almost spicy, which I love - will absolutely continue to purchase this product once I plow through this bottle.

The application of the sunscreen is smooth and did not clog my pores!!! Once again, I was put off by how small the product was but I actually like it this way, as it easily can fit in my purse without taking up too much space. This is worth the wait and money. I hope the company continues to grow and expands more sizes for the product as well as other items.
Such a good sunscreen! Applies with no white cast which is always something I look for, I also have such a subtle natural glow after applying this. Sits super well under make up also

This facial sunscreen is exactly what I was looking for. Something that doesn't leave my face white at all and is also not thick or greasy. I feel great knowing it won't break me out as well. And great added skin benefits too like super hydrating and fades dark spots! A little goes a long way too. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Amazing Results in just a week!
avis.texte: I am shocked at how good this sunscreen is and how much it clears my skin in just a week! I always break out when using sunscreen and this product is actually clearing my skin! It doesn't feel or smell like sunblock at all and goes on so velvety smooth. It actually helps to control shine and I don't even need to use a primer under my makeup, not to mention it's very moisturizing. I am hooked and highly recommend it for anyone who struggles with skin issues. Simply amazing!!!

Best sunscreen I have ever used, and I've tried them all. It's light and soaks right into your skin without leaving any white cast and leaves a dewy glow. I've been so impressed with all Blume products.

I love this spf, it is lightweight, hydrating, and doesn't leave a white cast! Very happy that it doesn't smell like a typical sunscreen and is filled with beneficial ingredients for my oily acne prone skin. Highly recommend it!

The best daily sunscreen for my acne-prone skin! There is absolutely no greasy residue and it feels light on my face. The smell is also wonderful - slightly citrus but not too overpowering. Easily the best daily facial sunscreen I've ever used!
cosmetically elegant; not too greasy; tint is just right, doesn't make my very pale skin ghostly or orange. just wish it didn't smell so strongly

I'm very impressed with this sunscreen. The texture is milky and the tint means zero white cast plus it evens out my skin tone beautifully and it gives my skin a radiant glow without being heavy, sticky or greasy. I'm not a big fan of the scent but it's not a deal breaker for me and it dissipates quickly. I might get away with using just this (without needing foundation) + concealer and blush and I'd be good to go for an everyday natural makeup look when I don't have any active acne breakouts.

Such an amazing product. I only use mineral sunscreen and I've had a difficult time finding one that doesn't leave me looking like a ghost or like I got a bad spray tan. Doesn't leave me feeling greasy, either.

avis.titre: Exactly the sunscreen we've all been looking for!
avis.texte: My love story with Blume started several years ago when my skin started a rebellion as I entered my 30s. After using Meltdown Oil I was instantly loyal to this brand and was so excited for this sunscreen. Finding something that's not too heavy or greasy or clogs my pores is not an easy task, but Blume did it. From the cute little packaging I keep in my handbag so I have it all the time, to the lightweight feel of the sunscreen and the quick absorption, I'm hooked. It's the perfect compliment to the rest of my skincare routine, which is all Blume all the time!

Very happy with this product, it goes on smooth, works well under makeup and does it's job to protect from the sun. The applicator tip makes it easy to apply as well. This is my new go to for face sunscreen.

My new fave mineral sunscreen! Love the scent, doesnt leave a white cast and idk what's in it my skin stays moisturized all day! I have oily skin and every other sunscreen makes me so greasy but this one doesn't! I have a natural glow all day 10/10

avis.titre: Great product! Not greasy, a bit glowy, and evens out skin.
avis.texte: I'm a huge fan of this sunscreen! I think everyone will enjoy its lightweight texture and feel on this skin, and the added skincare ingredients are a huge plus so it's not only protective but nourishing. For oily skin folks like myself, I think Blume really nailed that fine balance between hydrating and not becoming greasy. I found on my first application (two full finger lengths of product) that while I immediately loved the slip and glide of this sunscreen and it made my skin really luminous and glowy, I was a little wary of it becoming oily and unpleasant later on. Instead, after 5-10 minutes of dry down time, Sunburst settles down and takes on a natural (read: not greasy) finish. That said, it's not a classic powdery matte finish so folks looking for a completely shine-free dry down may need some time to get used to this formula. I've also worn this sunscreen under makeup a half dozen times since getting it and I think it really shines then - my foundation lays smoothly over top of Sunburst. The tint/tone of this sunscreen is interesting: it absolutely does not have a white cast but the peachy tone won't give you foundation-level coverage. I think most people will find the slight tint to Sunburst mostly just evens out their complexion. Overall, I think this is an excellent sunscreen

Overall good but not great. This sunscreen has good sun protection, unscented, and definitely doesn't make my skin breakout. The only issue is that it pills when applied following the Blume meltdown moisturizer.
My new go-to sunscreen! Absolutely love everything about this product from the packaging to the formulation, it is SO much better than all other sunscreens I've used in the past.
I am obsessed with this product. This has to be the BEST sunscreen I've ever used!!! As someone with sensitive skin and acne scars, I am beyond thrilled to have a sunscreen that works for me.

What I love about this sunscreen from Blume is that it's not only protecting my skin, but it's maintaining healthy skin with its extra ingredients! A double bonus! It goes on smooth - easy to apply and easy to throw in my purse and go. I love it!

Very dewy and does not seem to irritate my very sensitive skin! It does feel a bit like a "layer" on my skin, but I think thats expected since it literally is one. I also haven't noticed a cast or pilling which I was struggling with with my previous sunscreen.

I have so much trouble finding a sunscreen that 1. Doesnt leave a white cast 2. Doesnt make my skin break out horribly THIS IS IT! Thank you for listening and creating this product. So far its the only sunscreen that doesnt cause break outs. Thank you!!
I love this product. It goes on nice and doesn't feel oily. I also have acne scars and I love knowing this will help protect my skin and fade the spots i already have! 10/10
Absolutely one of the best spf I have used! Blends in so nicely. Doesn't make my skin break out .

avis.titre: Easy, smooth application, worth the money
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen a lot! It goes on smoothly and doesn't leave a white residue. Honestly, I wish it were mattifying, but that's hard to come by in a sunscreen so I can't be too mad about it.
I love this sunscreen so much!! It does amazing things for my skin and I'm obsessed. I cannot wait to see the progress it makes on my acne-prone skin.

avis.titre: The Holy Grail of sunscreens and skin care
avis.texte: Honestly the best sunscreen I've ever tried! I bought it for my teenage son with autism since he doesn't allow me to put too much product on his face. He has acne and this holy grail formula is exactly what he needed. I've been using it on myself too and love the effortless and light formula. Keep up the great work!!!

avis.titre: Love the formula, sits well under makeup!
avis.texte: I love the formula, it's completely non-greasy and sits so well under makeup. I also love that it's SPF 50, which is a lot higher than most face sunscreens in the market right now. I've been wearing it everyday since I got it, and it makes me feel extra pretty & protected during my hot girl walks especially in direct sunlight :)
I love this product so much!! One of the best purchases I have made this year.
This was such a great item, definitely an essential to incorporate into your routine.
Really love the finish it gives unlike that chalky finish some sunscreens have. I also like its water resistance!!! Def my go to for the summer!

This is my new favourite spf!!! It doesn't smell weird, like oranges. It also blends in so well. I love how it's not thick and is super light weight. I also like how it has benefits for the skin like fading spots and is acne prone safe!! make sure you check this one out!!!

avis.titre: A sunscreen that does it all!
avis.texte: It's not just a sunscreen, it's a vibe! First of all, doesn't leave a white cast. Looks awesome under makeup. Has anti inflammatory ingredients which makes it perfect for sensitive and acne prone skin. Quite lightweight and smells like oranges what more do you ask? Love it and will keep buying!
Honestly neck and neck with another favorite of mine. But this is like butter to the skin and as a dark skin woman it leaves no white cast and has a beautiful glow to it

Blume's Sunburst Mineral SPF 50 sunscreen is a mineral-based sunscreen designed to provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays. With SPF 50, this sunscreen offers high-level protection against UVB rays, reducing the risk of sunburn and skin damage . The sunscreen is formulated with skin-friendly and environmentally conscious ingredients. The texture of the sunscreen is lightweight and easy to blend into the skin without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling. This is important for comfortable daily wear. This leaves no white cast which is very important for me. It fades dark spots and acne scars It evens out skin tone and calms down inflammation and keeps your skin hydrated and nourished.
I liked how well this blended out. It was a great foundation for the rest of my makeup. Everything layered beautifully!

I really like the lightweight texture and it leaves my skin a nice hint of shimmer. It makes my skin look so radiant and it doesn't leave any white cast. It is a perfect base for makeup and overall, a great sunscreen with a light citrusy scent!
No white cast! It's super lightweight & dries down sheer with a refreshing citrus scent that I am loving! Works really well with makeup too!
Love love love the formula! Feels so lightweight on the skin and it perfect under makeup or to wear by itself.
Never have I ever heard of sunscreen that also treats acne dark spots! What a dream! Love the formula and I will be using it everyday!

This is my new favourite sunscreen! I absolutely love that it contains so many good skincare ingredients, doesn't leave a white cast, is so easy to blend in and the size is so handy to just carry around in my handbag!

avis.titre: The Perfect Sunscreen for Your Skincare Routine!
avis.texte: The perfect sunscreen for my daily routine! The Blume Sunburst Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen works amazing for my skin. I use it as the last step of my skincare routine for no makeup days and as a base for my foundation or skin tint for makeup days!
Love how this sunscreen leaves no white cast and has a lovely light citrus scent on the skin.
Amazing sunscreen! My go to for everyday. I am in love with the ingredients and the glow

Literally one of the best spfs I've ever tried! It went on really nicely, blended out with no white cast, sat beautifully underneath my makeup and sat beautifully alone and gave me a glowy but not greasy look!!!

First off, the sunscreen smells so good like fresh oranges. The sunscreen is light and does not feel greasy. It blends in well with my skin and leaves a dewy glow. This SPF was definitely worth waiting for!
I love how this spf is light and leaves a beauty glow to the skin! It's perfect for a natural summer look!

Loving the new and much needed sunscreen!!! This product feels and looks great on my skin. It has caused ZERO irritation (which many other SPFs leave my skin a mess) between skin sensitivity, rashes (due to harsh chemical use,) and clogged pores. SUNBURST tackles all these issues!!
This was an impulse buy, after running out of the sunscreen I was using, good purchase. Doesn't leave any white cast or greasy feeling!

Its not thick and gloppy like most sunblocks. its also not pasty white either. It goes on really well, doesnt have any harsh smell,and didnt leave me feeling like a sticky mess. I used it in conjuction with meltdown oil that I use daily.

avis.titre: Blume finally had an SPF and I'm so happy about it!
avis.texte: I've been waiting for Blume to release a sunscreen and I am in love! It's been so hard for me to find SPF that works with my oily skin that won't end up greasy and eventually stinging my eyes. The packaging is so cute and it has a very faint citrus scent, not like sunscreen. I was a bit worried when applying it because it seemed like it would be greasy, but it gave me a matte finish and stayed nicely the whole day! I will definitely be getting this again!!
So far, so good! This works great under my makeup and doesn't break me out. LOVE my Blume products!

I loved using this sunscreen! It's lightweight but still spf 50, which is hard to find! The serum like formula was very favorable for my combination skin. It also didn't feel like it was clogging my pores and left a smooth, dewy finish.
For my black skin it doesn't leave a very noticeable white cast, plus it's slightly mattifying.
Love how it absorbs into the skin and has no white cast afterwards!
Very lightweight and didn't make my skin greasy. Honestly doesn't feel like I'm wearing sunscreen at all, so easy to incorporate into my morning routine!

The packaging is super cute and vibrant and compact! I was a bit skeptical being mineral and tinted on brown skin but it blended fairly well though it took some time. Very minimal cast on MY brown skin tone.

First things first, the packaging kills me! It's so perfect for an SPF. I've been hoping Blume would release an SPF for a couple years and I'm so happy it's mineral!! However, unlike other mineral spf, the tint on this leaves no white cast and the texture is great - it's not thick so there's no trouble applying and no greasy feeling after!! What else would I expect from the best skincare brand??

avis.titre: I am now a sunscreen girly I've been converted
avis.texte: I am now a sunscreen girly! Seriously I have spent years looking for something as light weight and comfortable but also actually protective for my skin and this is it! Love the formula, love that it's not scented and it blends into my skin so easily! By far my favorite tinted sunscreen and it's mineral! Like how can you go wrong

This is the best sunscreen I have ever used and I don't know why I would even doubt it coming from Blume. It's light and doesn't feel cakey. It's a really nice feel, doesn't sting my eyes, and looks fabulous under make up. Gives a great glow! 10/10. Will absolutely continue buying. My new favorite sunscreen!!
I love love this spf it left No white cast blends in so well. I love that it's water resistant feels very light weight I highly recommend
It is light, smells amazing and it does not leave me looking like a mime

avis.titre: I promise, this is the BEST spf ever!!! I'm SO acne-prone an
avis.texte: Truly THE BEST SPF on the market. It has a really nice, light, fresh citrus scent (I'm addicted to it!!!), melts right into my skin PERFECTLY, leaves no white cast, and the best part is - I haven't broken out at all! I'm someone who is always VERY hesitant to try new skincare because of how sensitive and acne-prone I am (I'll break out 2/3 of the time), so being able to find an SPF that feels nice on my skin and under makeup, is mineral-based, helps with my scarring, and does not break me out is a dream come true. THANK YOU, BLUMEEEE!
